messages:
jordan: Kicking off staggered rollout for service/v2.3.1 across US / EU / APAC. Plan: US warm 20% -> EU warm 15% -> APAC warm 10%. Holding on capacity sign-off before pinning.

maria: Quick note — EU thermal cushion is 12% today, we should keep EU warm under 10% until 03:30 UTC.

leo: US reserved capacity shows 5 spare slots in the warm pool. That covers a 20% ramp for ~30m.

cami: APAC GPUs still under maintenance in ap-northeast-1, warm pool only available in ap-southeast-1 (smaller). Recommend lower APAC initial slice to 6%.

jordan: OK, reduce APAC warm to 6%. Maria/Leo, can you both +1 to pin v2.3.1 for US and EU? I want deploy-bot to start canary after pin.

maria: +1 EU (but will monitor thermal). I'll cut the EU canary if CPU > 78% for >3m.

leo: +1 US. Tracking memory headroom metric. Alert threshold set: mem_free_pct < 18% -> rollback.

deploy-bot: Starting canary slice: region=us, slice=20%, version=service/v2.3.1, canary_duration=10m. Canary ID: cb-9031

sam: FYI release-notes snippet (for onboarding): "Perf improvements for caching + reduced p99 latency for short context prompts. Backwards-compatible." I'll drop this in the release channel after warm checks pass.

ops-bot: Canary cb-9031 smoke results: 200/200 requests OK, avg p95=128ms, p99=310ms. No errors.

cami: Can you paste the p99 trend for the last 5m?

deploy-bot: p99 trend (last 5m) for cb-9031: [280, 295, 305, 312, 310] ms

maria: EU hold: starting EU canary at 10% (reduced from 15) for 8m. Version pinned = service/v2.3.1. Canary ID: cb-9032

ops-bot: Canary cb-9032 smoke results initial: 50/50 OK, p95=180ms, p99=420ms. Thermal at 11.6% (close).

leo: US p99 looks stable. Unless someone raises a hard stop, I say roll US to 100% in waves (50% -> 100% over 15m).

cami: APAC warm at 6% is live. Canary cb-9033 started: 30/30 OK, p95=240ms, p99=610ms. Note APAC p99 is higher due to smaller instances.

jordan: Decision tree: if any region p99 rises >25% vs baseline or thermal > 75% of cushion, trigger pause and pin previous version. Rollback manual trigger: @maria or @leo.

maria: Captured. I've also added a short rollback playbook: 
- Pause deploy-bot (deploy-bot pause cb-XXXX)
- Pin old version: api pin service v2.3.0
- Rehydrate warm pool with old images
- Notify customers via status page if >10m outage

sam: Added release-note line about canary thresholds and rollback triggers. Will post release doc once all three regions hit stable p99 < +10% baseline for 10m.

deploy-bot: US rollout wave1 -> 50% started (wave_id=w1-us). Expected finish: 9m.

ops-bot: US wave1 health: 95% of traces <= p95 target, p99 drift +4%. No errors.

leo: Moving US to 100% now. wave2 -> 100% initiated.

maria: EU still warming, p99 drift +12% at minute 4. I'm holding EU wave and throttling to 8%.

cami: APAC p99 stabilized after switching to larger batch size config. Keeping APAC at 6% for now.

jordan: Final checklist: release notes posted? sam? SLA knobs checked? leo/maria? rollback watch assigned?

sam: Release notes posted to #release-notes with link: https://intranet/release/serv-v2-3-1.

leo: SLA knobs verified. Autoscaler set to conservative ramp for next 40m.

maria: Rollback watch assigned: @maria (EU), @leo (US), @cami (APAC). Ops channel on standby.

jordan: Thanks team. Closing thread — will reopen if any pause/rollback happens. :thumbsup:
